reports.title: ADP Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: •Fiscal 2026 pre-tax gain of about $5 million related to a partial reversal of the workforce optimization initiatives from fiscal 2025 and 2024
•Fiscal 2026 pre-tax charges of about $91 million related to a business alignment program
•Fiscal 2026 pre-tax gain of about $8 million related to gains on ADP Ventures' investments
•Fiscal 2026 pre-tax net charges of about $18 million related to the settlement of a legal matter
•Fiscal 2027 pre-tax gain of about $3 million related to gains on ADP Ventures' investments
